chapter: The union and the 1920s-30s band scene
title: Radio broadcasts from the Examiner building and Vernon Country Club
summary: Mrs. Howard recalls singing on KNX with the Quality Serenaders while the band played Vernon Country Club.

story.theme_name: Radio and television work: staff jobs, shows and broadcasts
story.community_name: Working radio and television: network shows, studio staffs, talk-show bands

blocks.x: Was it KNX you just said?
I believe it was KNX, a station there in the old Examiner building. At that time, it wasn't old. I think that's where they first started their radio station.
Now, who was singing there? Can you mention their names?
I said, Roberta Heiseck and myself, or the both of us. We were there, they were playing at Vernon Country Club.
Do you remember that all right?
When you broadcast on the radio.
When did it happen more than once? Was it regular or was it one time?
Well, no. We broadcast, I believe, on
a Monday night, I think. I think it was (inaudible), because we were out there, I think, six weeks and we left there and went to Mike Lyman's, downtown at the Club Alabama, on Spring.
